description: Per-language AST-tester probe repos. SHAs are LOCKED for reproducibility — never bump without re-validating gold files. Add new languages via repo entry + matching eval/ast-tester-probes/gold/<key>.json.

repos.rationale: TSX const-extraction regression anchor (project_tsx_jsx_const_extraction.md). Heavy .tsx + server actions + parenthesised route segments.
Macro-heavy linter codebase. Exercises macro_rules!, lifetimes, derive macros, trait dispatch.
Idiomatic suspend/structured-concurrency, trailing lambdas, sealed interfaces with variance, inline+reified.
Modern C# 9-12 server. Heavy partial classes (RespServerSession across 30+ files), init-only props, ValueTask async, IAsyncEnumerable.
SIMD-portable library. Templates with non-type params, nested per-target namespaces (hwy::N_AVX3::), header-only inline patterns.
Google Gson JSON serialization library — 262 .java files, rich type adapter pattern with anonymous classes, wildcard generics, lambdas, and enum-with-bodies; exercises the full Java type system.
Pallets/click CLI library — 63 .py files; @t.overload decorator chains, generic-parameterized abstract classes (ParamType[T]), heavy use of typing.Callable + TypeVar.

Axios HTTP client library — 175 .js files; class-based architecture (Axios, AxiosHeaders, AxiosError, CancelToken, InterceptorManager), Axios.prototype[method] metaprogramming for HTTP verb dispatch, class extension.
Sinatra web DSL — 97 .rb files; module mixins (Helpers), `class << self` singleton blocks, Rack subclassing, `class X < Struct.new(...)` runtime superclass pattern.
go-chi HTTP router — 53 .go files; radix-trie routing, many receiver methods on Mux, interface embedding (Router embeds http.Handler + Routes), map-typed struct fields.
